item.tib: rig 'dzin bsgrub pa'i man ngag gzhung 'a mo
item.coloph: de nas rig 'dzin rnams rim gyis brgyud nas/ gshen dran pa ye shes la gtad/ mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ma dang / dran pa ye shes gnyis kyis/ bon la dar nub byung dus su/ bon 'di la rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum du phyes/ rgyas pa dran pa ye shes phyag tu bsnams/ bsdus pa yum chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs la gab/ 'bring po rma gnyan pom rar gter du sbas/ dus kyi mtha' ma dar ba'i smon lam btab/ de nas dus dang las kyis dbang bsgyar nas/ dben gnas dam pa g.yu khra lha stengs su/ yum cig mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ma'i/ (yis) dus mtha'i rnal 'byor bdag la snyan du brgyud/ bdag gi sbas dang gsang rgya thub par byas/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la bzod par gsol/ bka' skyongs srung mas dbyings nas mi bskyon par/ rjes 'jug nyes pa'i bdud las rab rgyal nas/ bla med rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu myur thob shog slob dpon pad+ma'i gsungs ltar/ phyi rab blo dman gyi don du/ bdag rnal 'byor rdor rje gling pas/ bsnyan (snyan) rgyud la bcos slad med par bkod pa 'dis/ 'gro kun bla med sangs rgyas sa thob shog/
